jobs.title: .Net Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen de energiemarkt!

Zie jij uitdaging in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van softwareoplossingen? Bij Scholt Energy krijg je de kans om een belangrijke rol te spelen in de snel veranderende energiemarkt. Samen met een team van 10 tot 15 gedreven ontwikkelaars vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar slimme informatievoorzieningen en systeemintegraties die risico's verminderen en de efficiëntie verhogen. Jouw communicatieve vaardigheden zorgen ervoor dat projecten succesvol worden afgerond, terwijl je de kwaliteit van de software en documentatie hooghoudt. Je vertaalt wensen naar softwareoplossingen en houdt daarbij rekening met technische en functionele eisen, waarborgt de kwaliteit en zorgt voor een actuele documentatie.

Bij Scholt Energy doe je meer dan alleen software onderhouden; door onze aanhoudende groei werk je actief mee aan het ontwikkelen en toevoegen van nieuwe functionaliteiten die ons én de energiemarkt naar een hoger niveau tillen!

Wat breng je mee:

Een bachelorsdiploma, bijvoorbeeld in informatica of een vergelijkbare richting, aangevuld met minimaal vijf jaar relevante werkervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling of integratie.
Sterke kennis van .NET C#, waarbij ervaring met TypeScript of JavaScript, SQL, Azure en het Microsoft Power Platform worden gezien als een pre.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, initiëren en realiseren van softwareoplossingen binnen vastgestelde architectuur- en beveiligingsrichtlijnen.
Het vermogen om teams te ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling en implementatie van informatievoorzieningsoplossingen en om de impact van proces- en systeemwijzigingen nauwkeurig te analyseren.
Ervaring met het bewaken van integraties, inclusief monitoring, root cause analyses en het verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid.
Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde manier van werken waardoor documentatie, rapportages en informatiestromen altijd volledig, duidelijk en actueel zijn.
Het vermogen om als intern en extern aanspreekpunt te fungeren voor de doorontwikkeling van software en integraties, inclusief technische advisering op het gebied van inrichting en maatwerk.
Ervaring in het opstellen en evalueren van businesscases.
Een vooruitdenkende instelling, gecombineerd met analytisch vermogen en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, waardoor je complexe vraagstukken helder weet over te brengen.

Wat wij jou bieden:

Een organisatie met een duidelijke visie: klimaat neutrale energie voor alle bedrijven. Wij ondersteunen onze klanten en partners in de energietransitie. We zijn ambitieus, maar tegelijkertijd realistisch over wat haalbaar is.
Een open, betrokken en professionele bedrijfscultuur: bij ons staat een persoonlijke aanpak voorop maar tegelijkertijd blijven we professioneel en gefocust. We vinden het belangrijk dat collega’s het naar hun zin hebben en met een eNPS (medewerkerstevredenheid) van maar liefst +37 weten we dit met z’n allen te bereiken.
Werkplezier als vast onderdeel van je baan. We vieren successen. Dit doen we door onder andere elke werkweek af te sluiten met een borrel, verschillende sportevents te organiseren, een jaarlijkse teamactiviteit en een internationaal bedrijfsuitje met collega’s uit al onze landen. Jij kiest wat je leuk vindt en waarbij je graag aansluit.
Een internationaal team dat jou verwelkomt. Gedreven collega’s uit verschillende landen die uitkijken naar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie.
Bij ons creëer jij zélf je kansen. Wie initiatief toont en wil groeien, kan bereiken wat hij of zij wil. Jij bepaalt het tempo én de richting; wij zorgen voor de mogelijkheden. Er is geen vast opleidingsbudget: iedere training, opleiding of cursus die jou sterker maakt in je rol én bijdraagt aan onze gezamenlijke ambities, ondersteunen we volledig. In 2025 stroomden maar liefst 102 collega’s intern door naar een nieuwe functie — simpelweg omdat ze hun kansen grepen en hun eigen pad vormgaven.
Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Met waaronder vakantiegeld, een zorgeloos pensioen, een fietsplan en 28 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om tot 5 extra dagen bij te kopen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
Flexibel werken mét persoonlijke verbinding. Start je dag tussen 7.00 en 9.00 uur. Je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op kantoor en de rest kan je (indien gewenst) werken vanuit thuis. Daarvoor ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding én €250 om jouw thuiswerkplek naar wens in te richten. Je ontvangt deze vergoeding ongeacht of jij jouw thuiswerkplek al hebt ingericht of niet.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.Net)
jobs.description:
We're not your typical fashion company. At Suitsupply, technology isn't support — it's the engine. Every platform, every customer experience, every global operation is built in-house by our own engineers. And we're growing.
If you're a senior engineer who takes ownership, lifts the people around you, and gets genuinely excited about building things that matter at scale — keep reading.
WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

You'll design, build and evolve the systems that power a global tailoring brand — from customer-facing apps to complex backend services. Concretely:
Architect and ship new applications and services using Azure (Service Bus, Functions, Cosmos DB, Table Storage, Bicep and more)
Own and improve CI/CD pipelines that keep our teams moving fast
Raise the bar on code quality through solid unit testing and peer reviews
Build integrations with best-in-class platforms: Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, supply chain & WMS systems, POS, OMS, WeChat and more
Work in an AI-augmented engineering environment — CursorAI and GitHub Copilot are in your toolkit from day one, with real opportunities to push further

WHO YOU ARE

You don't just write code — you understand the domain, challenge assumptions, and make the people around you better.
5+ years of C# and .NET experience, with serious depth
Strong grasp of DDD, microservices, event-driven architecture, and Azure
Fluent with Web APIs, Service Bus, messaging patterns, unit testing and Git
A team player who takes ownership and drives continuous improvement — not because you have to, but because you can't help it
Bonus: hands-on experience with AI-powered dev tools (CursorAI, GitHub Copilot or similar)

WHAT YOU'LL GET

Autonomy — no endless sign-off chains. You own your work and your decisions carry real weight
Growth — flat structure, cross-team mobility, and a culture that genuinely invests in your development
AI-first environment — licensed access to CursorAI, GitHub Copilot and emerging tools; be at the frontier, not catching up
Style — 40% discount on Suitsupply's full collection. You'll look the part.
Purpose — we build technology that's sustainable, ethical, and built to last. Just like our suits.

Suitsupply is on a journey to become the world's leading tailoring expert. The technology to get there is being built right here, in Amsterdam, by a team that gives a damn.
Ready to be part of it?
We support relocation from the EU

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET) – Medior / Senior
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van Nederland

Wil jij als Full Stack Developer werken aan slimme digitale oplossingen die dagelijks impact hebben op de inrichting van de openbare ruimte en infrastructuur? Bij CROW krijg je de kans om moderne technologieën zoals .NET, React, Azure, Elasticsearch en AI in te zetten voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen software, maar helpt ook mee aan de digitale transformatie van een organisatie die richting geeft aan de leefomgeving van Nederland. Of je nu een ervaren medior bent of een senior die graag technische koers bepaalt en collega's inspireert: bij CROW krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen, te vernieuwen en écht het verschil te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen het team Digitale Informatie is behoefte ontstaan om onze developmentcapaciteit op korte termijn uit te breiden. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een Full Stack Developer die zelfstandig werkt aan zowel backend- als frontendontwikkeling en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze digitale informatievoorziening.

Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische technische oplossingen en realiseert deze zelfstandig. Daarbij denk je actief mee over architectuur, schaalbaarheid, innovatie en de inzet van moderne technologieën.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van backend-applicaties in .NET/C#.
Het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van API's en data access patterns.
Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van frontendfunctionaliteiten met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Het meedenken over softwarearchitectuur en technische verbeteringen.
Het werken met zoektechnologieën zoals Elasticsearch.
Het onderzoeken en implementeren van AI-toepassingen, waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Het inrichten en onderhouden van cloud deployments en CI/CD-processen binnen een Azure- en GitHub-omgeving.
Het samenwerken met collega's, product owners en andere stakeholders om onze digitale dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een salaris tussen € 4.522,- en € 6.908,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.
Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week, bij voorkeur fulltime.
25 vakantiedagen en 12 adv-dagen.
Een persoonlijk keuzebudget bestaande uit 6 (van de 12) ADV dagen, eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld.
Een premievrije pensioenopbouw.
Hybride werken, met een thuiswerk-, internet- en eenmalige werkplekvergoeding.
Een laptop en moderne tooling om optimaal te kunnen werken.
Een maandelijks vitaliteitsbudget en korting op je sportschoolabonnement via onze bedrijfsregeling.
Volop ruimte voor opleiding en ontwikkeling op het gebied van cloud, AI en moderne softwareontwikkeling.
Een uitgebreid introductie- en inwerkprogramma.
Een uitdagende functie binnen een ambitieuze organisatie met maatschappelijke impact.

Jij voelt je hier thuis als...

je energie krijgt van eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid;
je zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook graag samenwerkt met collega's;
je enthousiast wordt van een omgeving waarin technologie continu in ontwikkeling is;
je graag werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe technologieën;
je het leuk vindt om zowel backend als frontend op te pakken.

Jouw talent

Je kijkt verder dan individuele features en denkt vanuit het grotere geheel. Je begrijpt hoe systemen samenhangen, hebt oog voor technische verbeteringen en combineert analytisch vermogen met een pragmatische, hands-on instelling. Je schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare en goed gedocumenteerde code.

Wij zoeken een van de volgende profielen:

Medior Full Stack Developer

Circa 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Basiskennis van frontendontwikkeling met React of Angular.
Basiskennis van cloudtechnologie en CI/CD.
Interesse om je verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van AI, RAG en Elasticsearch.

Senior Full Stack Developer

Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Ervaring met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Brede ervaring met Azure, GitHub, CI/CD en cloud deployment.
Ervaring met Elasticsearch en AI-oplossingen zoals Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
In staat om architectuurkeuzes te maken, richting te geven aan technische ontwikkelingen en collega's te coachen.

Verder

Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk..
Ben je woonachtig in Nederland zodat je ook op kantoor met collega’s kunt verbinden.

Over CROW

Zonder CROW zou Nederland er heel anders uit zien. Zodra je de deur uitgaat en om je heen kijkt, zie je een openbare ruimte en infrastructuur die is vormgegeven met behulp van onze richtlijnen, systematieken en praktische tools. CROW ontwikkelt deze breed gedragen collectieve richtlijnen en kennis samen met belangrijke partijen als opdrachtgevers, opdrachtnemers, adviseurs en toeleveranciers. Wij vervullen hierbij een belangrijke verbindende rol.

CROW faciliteert kennisdeling, bevordert kennistoepassing en duidt beschikbare informatie. CROW richt zich hierbij op de praktijk van vandaag en morgen. CROW bevindt zich in de overgangsfase van een traditioneel kennisbedrijf naar een kennisbedrijf wat zich ook op de digitalisering van deze kennis richt. Een belangrijk doel is om de gebruikers van de kennis van CROW (onze klanten) zo optimaal mogelijk te bedienen door de juiste content in de juiste vorm en juiste samenhang digitaal aan te bieden in het werkproces van de klant.

Wil je meer weten?

Voor meer informatie over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met Rick Otterloo, Productowner via rick.otterloo@crow.nl.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Werk jij graag met moderne front-end technologie en wil je bijdragen aan een grote migratie van een Sitecore- naar een headless ContentStack-omgeving? Word Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r. in Heerlen.

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack Developer bij a.s.r.
je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

Dit bieden we je
een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met businessanalyse, requirementsanalyse en technische analyse
communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Hier ga je werken als Fullstack Developer in Heerlen
Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Samen met ongeveer 7 DevOps-engineers, een product owner en een scrum master werk je aan de Loyalis-website en de verwerking van nieuwe polisaanvragen. Daarbij krijg je te maken met verschillende technologieën, zoals Sitecore en ContentStack, Vue en Nuxt, .NET-services en OutSystems. De komende periode staat in het teken van belangrijke vernieuwingen, waardoor je volop kunt meebouwen aan de toekomst van het platform. Het team werkt in sprints van 3 weken en komt 2 keer per week samen op kantoor voor overleg, samenwerking en kennisdeling. De overige dagen kun je vanuit huis werken. Loyalis, een merk van a.s.r., is dé verzekeraar voor inkomen en zekerheid binnen de sectoren overheid, onderwijs, zorg, vervoer, bouw en nutsbedrijven. We bieden producten en diensten op het gebied van arbeidsongeschiktheid en helpen onze klanten om uitval te voorkomen. Werken bij Loyalis heeft nog méér voordelen: een fijne werksfeer, een uitstekende werk-privébalans, alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen én de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken! Hier lees je meer over werken bij Loyalis.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Wij werken op een prettige manier samen met een aantal preferred suppliers. Acquisitie door werving-en-selectie-, detacherings- of uitzendbureaus wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager for a growing SaaS organization in Utrecht. The international engineering team currently consists of 11 professionals and is entering an important next phase: transitioning from one team into two, and potentially three autonomous, cross-functional teams. Hybrid working environment in Utrecht.

jobs.title: QA (Automation) Engineer
jobs.description:
# QA (Automation) Engineer - End to End

## About the Role

Priva is seeking a **QA Automation Engineer** focused on **end-to-end testing of distributed software systems**. This role will establish a coherent, platform-level quality approach across the capabilities owned by **Team Mobius and Team Rangers**, bringing together existing integration and system-level testing approaches rather than creating another isolated test suite.

You will work across services and teams to identify dependencies, data flows, failure modes, and operational risks, then translate those risks into maintainable automated tests and stronger release evidence. You will collaborate with engineers, QA colleagues, Product, architects, application teams, and support specialists while helping teams take greater ownership of quality.

## Key Responsibilities

- Create and maintain a platform-level **end-to-end test strategy** covering critical customer and operational journeys across services.
- Map system boundaries, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes.
- Translate the highest operational risks into executable test scenarios.
- Build and maintain automated tests using real service interfaces and representative environments.
- Bring existing team-level test frameworks and suites into a coherent approach.
- Reuse effective testing capabilities and remove unnecessary duplication.
- Define patterns for test data, environments, identity, and dependency management to make cross-service tests repeatable and diagnosable.
- Integrate **smoke, regression, and end-to-end tests** into CI/CD pipelines.
- Provide useful test reporting and clear ownership of failures.
- Coordinate cross-team test preparation for changes affecting multiple services, consumers, or production environments.
- Use telemetry, logs, traces, and test evidence to diagnose failures.
- Distinguish product defects from environment or data issues.
- Assess release risk and communicate residual risk clearly.
- Help teams make evidence-based release decisions.
- Coach engineers and QA colleagues on testability, system-level thinking, and effective test automation.
- Enable teams to own quality rather than acting solely as a final testing gate.

## Required Qualifications

- Professional experience in **integration, system, or end-to-end testing of distributed software systems**.
- Strong **test automation** skills, including the ability to create maintainable frameworks, libraries, and workflows.
- Programming or scripting experience in at least one language commonly used for test automation, such as:
- C#
- Python
- TypeScript
- PowerShell
- Experience testing **REST APIs, asynchronous integrations, data flows, and service-to-service authentication**.
- Practical **CI/CD** experience, including automated test execution, result publishing, and failure investigation.
- Working knowledge of **cloud environments, containers, networking, configuration, and observability**.
- Ability to reason across team and service boundaries, identify hidden dependencies, and prioritize the highest operational risks.
- Collaborative approach focused on enabling teams to own quality.
- Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-alignment skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with **Microsoft Azure**.
- Experience with **Azure DevOps or GitHub-based delivery workflows**.
- Experience with tools such as:
- Playwright
- Reqnroll or SpecFlow
- Robot Framework
- Pytest
- Pester
- xUnit
- Comparable test automation tooling
- Experience with **SQL**, data-platform testing, multi-tenant systems, or historical time-series data.
- Experience with **IoT Edge, gateways, MQTT, remote device communication**, or mixed cloud and edge solutions.
- Experience with performance, resilience, security, or compatibility testing of distributed systems.
- Experience in building automation, horticulture, operational technology, or systems with physical-world dependencies.

## Skills & Competencies

- End-to-end testing
- Integration testing
- System testing
- QA automation
- Test automation frameworks
- Automated test development
- REST API testing
- Asynchronous integration testing
- Data-flow testing
- Service-to-service authentication
- CI/CD
- Smoke testing
- Regression testing
- Distributed systems
- Cloud environments
- Containers
- Networking
- Configuration management
- Observability
- Telemetry, logs, and traces
- Failure investigation and root-cause analysis
- Release risk assessment
- Test data and environment management
- Cross-service dependency analysis
- Stakeholder communication
- Technical documentation
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Coaching and quality enablement

## Education & Experience

**Education**

- No specific education requirement is stated in the source job description.

**Experience**

- Professional experience in integration, system, or end-to-end testing of distributed software systems.
- Strong experience developing maintainable test automation frameworks, libraries, and workflows.
- Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous integrations, data flows, authentication, and CI/CD.
- Experience working across service and team boundaries.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

- **Location:** De Lier, Zuid-Holland, Netherlands

Priva develops intelligent control systems for sustainable and reliable greenhouse and building environments. Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen mit Visual Studio 2022

24-Month Secure ANÜ Engagement — Up to €100,000 p.a. — 60% Home Office — 2 Positions

THE ROLE

Most C# work in Germany is line-of-business applications — CRUD screens, internal tooling, someone else's database. This is device and system software: the code that runs on the instruments themselves, in a company whose products are used to test and secure the communications infrastructure other companies depend on.

You would implement device and system software in C++ and C#, take requirements through analysis and conceptualisation yourself rather than receiving finished tickets, and integrate what you build into existing systems that are already in the field. Two positions are open, so this is a team being grown rather than a gap being filled.

YOU WILL
Implement device and system software in C++ and C# — the software that runs on the products, not the software that reports on them
Take requirements from analysis through to conceptualisation for software components, working out what needs building rather than being handed a specification
Integrate new software components into existing software systems already deployed with customers
Write automated component and system tests as part of delivery, so correctness is proven rather than assumed
Work inside an established agile team with Jira, alongside engineers who know the hardware as well as the code

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
Completed degree in computer science or a comparable field — this one is checked, not assumed
Excellent object-oriented development in C#, and ideally C++ alongside it. C# leads here; strong C# with credible C++ is in scope
Solid working knowledge of design patterns, applied on real systems rather than recognised from a book
PostgreSQL — you have designed against it and queried it, not just connected to it
Experience delivering inside an agile software team, ideally with Jira
Good German — this is a German engineering environment and the working language reflects that
Citizenship of an EU member state or an allied nation. This position is subject to export control regulations, so it is a hard requirement rather than a preference

ADVANTAGEOUS
Knowledge of mobile communication protocols — genuinely useful here rather than a nice line on a CV
Background in test and measurement, secure communications, broadcast or another instrumentation-led environment
Experience where the software ships on a device and cannot be patched weekly, so quality is designed in
Automated test frameworks at component and system level

Two positions on the same requisition, which is unusual — it means budget is signed off for a pair and there is no single-seat bottleneck holding it up.
60% home office on embedded-adjacent work is rare. Device and system software normally means the lab, five days a week. Here it is two days on site in Munich and the rest wherever you work best.

jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe

Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work
list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join our Engineering experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions
team
. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

What You’ll Do

As an Expert Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead the development and building of software applications that address complex business and technology problems in various industries. You will guide a diverse engineering team through the entire engineering life cycle. Your responsibilities will include designing, developing, optimizing, and deploying cutting-edge software engineering solutions and infrastructure at the production scale required by the world’s largest companies, with a strong focus on ensuring technical delivery supports business strategy, operating model evolution, and sustainable value creation.

Shape & scope client solutions. Work with Bain consulting teams and product owners to translate business problems into prioritized backlogs and technical roadmaps for cross-functional engineering squads
Translate technical capabilities into client-ready product and transformation outcomes by shaping product direction, operating model implications, and change management approaches that support adoption and measurable business impact
Own full-stack design & build. Lead the architecture, development and documentation of AI applications, including coding and integrating third-party services or frameworks that accelerate delivery and long-term maintainability
Establish AI-native software engineering best practices. Define and enforce standards around component libraries/design systems, automated testing, linting, CI/CD, accessibility and performance optimization
Develop reusable libraries & accelerators. Create and curate shared code assets that reduce time-to-value across multiple client projects and internal initiatives.
Lead the full delivery lifecycle. Set quality gates, supervise code reviews, ensure robust unit/integration test coverage, manage release planning, and oversee post-deployment monitoring and incident resolution
Partner on UI/UX excellence. Collaborate with designers to ship inclusive, responsive interfaces
Mentor & grow engineers. Provide day-to-day technical coaching for senior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, architecture sessions and constructive feedback
Upskill client engineering teams. Coach client developers on modern tooling and DevOps/cloud-native practices, ensuring sustainable ownership after Bain’s engagement
Advance AI-native technology adoption. Champion containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated observability and secure-by-design principles to improve scalability, reliability and security
Contribute to communities of practice. Share lessons learned and emerging technology trends through internal forums, brown-bag sessions and knowledge assets
Support talent acquisition & onboarding. Participate in interviewing, technical assessments and mentoring of new hires to build a high-caliber engineering cohort
Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs

About You

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
6+ years of end-to-end experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade full-stack applications
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into solution, platform products or roadmaps
4+ years building server-side services using FastAPI, Node.js/Express, Flask, Django, .NET Core or Java Spring Boot or similar technologies, including the design of APIs
3+ years of architecting and operating micro-service ecosystems, emphasizing service discovery, observability, CI/CD automation and blue-/green or canary deployments
Expert knowledge of Python, JavaScript and/or other programming languages
Experience with cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure or GCP, knowledge of managed services, serverless patterns and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Bicep
Proficient with containerization and orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes and related tooling (Helm, Argo CD)
Experience with database architecture across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), with solid SQL skills
Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented and functional paradigms, automated testing, performance profiling
Excellence in software architecture design, including modular, distributed, and cloud-native systems, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability
Experience with data security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO/cloud IAM, encryption in transit, at rest, and awareness of data protection regulations.
Ideally, experience with modern AI/ML development, working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic SDKs and AI safety
Ideally, hands-on experience with modern web technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
Proven leader and mentor with ability to lead engineering squads, set coding standards, perform rigorous code reviews and up skill junior engineers.
Agile delivery mindset, practical experience with Scrum or Kanban, story-point estimation, backlog grooming and the use of Git-based workflows, Jira and automated CI/CD pipelines.
Professional fluency in English and German

Interpersonal Skills

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms and techniques with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams
Ability to work independently and juggle priorities to thrive in a fast paced and ambiguous environment, while also collaborating as part of a team in complex situations

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design and Development who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. As a Member Of The Web Design And Development Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Volunteer Logistics

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

English

8+ years of progressively responsible web design and development experience, including at least 2-3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Language Products | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Language Products Track
. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire product-obsessed
people who care deeply about the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the translation flow, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.
Front-end Heavy Full-Stack Fluency: You are a strong Front End engineer who is comfortable traversing the stack to deliver a feature. You can build a highly interactive, performant UI in React and design the supporting backend logic in Python and C#/.NET Core, with the support of agentic tooling.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.
A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You can design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
What’s the role?

Gen II is building out its Data & Integration Platform — the central integration backbone connecting 40+ systems across our fund administration technology estate. At the heart of DIP is an AI-assisted integration factory: a structured, repeatable delivery engine for building, testing, and deploying integration adapters at pace.

We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to join the DIP team and take direct ownership of integration delivery — combining deep Azure integration expertise with an embedded AI-assisted development practice. This is not a role for someone who is learning how to use AI tooling; we want someone who already works this way and can help us push the factory model further.

You will be expected to come in, get up to speed quickly, and drive forward integration workstreams with minimal oversight. We need a self-starter who can take a requirement, own it end-to-end, and deliver at pace and quality. You will report to and work closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering.

What You’ll Be Doing

Integration Factory & AI-Assisted Delivery

Building and extending reusable system wrappers (Python) for applications and systems across the Gen II technology estate
Using AI tooling (LLMs, codegen, Claude) across all integration development — scaffolding Function Apps, generating Logic Apps workflows, producing APIM policies, building test cases, generating IaC, and automating documentation; AI assistance is the default mode of working, not a selective shortcut
Contributing to the factory’s pattern library — standardising error handling, retry logic, logging, and payload structures across all integration components
Driving CI/CD pipeline integration for adapter delivery — automated test execution, linting, and deployment gates

Azure Integration Engineering

Designing and building integration adapters using Azure Function Apps (Python) — the primary execution pattern across DIP
Developing Logic Apps Standard workflows, including WDL authoring, scope actions, error handling, and retry patterns — with AI-assisted workflow generation embedded in the build process
Configuring Azure API Management — inbound/outbound policies, managed identity auth, versioning, and throttling — leveraging AI to draft, validate, and document policies
Working with Azure Service Bus for event-driven and async messaging patterns
Contributing to IaC outputs (Bicep) for per-adapter infrastructure — using AI to scaffold and maintain templates

Delivery & Collaboration

Taking integration workstreams from requirement to production with minimal hand-holding
Writing clean, well-tested Python with pytest-based test suites aligned to DIP QA standards
Working closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering, DIP Architect, BAs, and QA — raising blockers early and documenting decisions clearly
Collaborating with data engineers to ensure ingress and egress integration outputs land cleanly in / out of Snowflake

The ideal background for this role:

5+ years of hands-on integration engineering experience — evidenced in role history, not just a skills list
Deep practical experience with Azure Function Apps, Logic Apps Standard, Service Bus, and API Management — you have written the workflows and configured the policies yourself
Strong Python development — clean, production-quality code with proper error handling, logging, and test coverage
Demonstrable experience building or contributing to an integration factory — reusable adapter patterns, scaffolding, CI/CD automation
Active use of AI-assisted development in integration delivery — pattern generation, code scaffolding, IaC templating, documentation automation; this should be embedded in how you work, not aspirational
Ability to own workstreams independently and drive delivery without close management
Experience writing system wrapper libraries — encapsulating authentication, API interaction, and error handling for third-party platforms (desirable)
Snowflake experience — querying, schema patterns, and structuring integration payloads for downstream consumption (desirable)
Exposure to fund administration or broader financial services environments (desirable)
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams

Role Location/Hybrid Schedule

This role is based in our Southampton office. Although the nature of most of the roles within Gen II cannot be classed as totally flexible, there is scope in some cases for a form of Agile Working. The different ways in which Agile Working can be undertaken is dependent on the demands and needs of the business, the office space available and the individual’s preferences and circumstances.

AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.

Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.

As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.

Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.

Job Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. We challenge where it matters and own the outcome. We combine strategic thinking, customer-centric service design, and agile engineering practices to accelerate innovation in a tech-driven world.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

Join our Digital & Data team working alongside product, design and a wide range of other experts and cross-disciplinary teams to bring ideas to life through innovative software solutions.
Grow a flexible and unique career within a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation, and curiosity. You have the option to progress with us on a technical career track. No need to go onto the Partner career track if this doesn’t align with what you want to do.
Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site minimum of 2 days per week.
Work on a broad variety of projects and tech stacks for clients across seven sectors - no project is ever the same
Join other experts within our supportive and collaborative tech community through knowledge-sharing and peer-level support, coaching and mentoring
Deepen your expertise through our a culture of learning and growth – you’ll have budget to take courses (technical and non-technical training), plus gain certifications

Our tech stack 🚀

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, you can expect to work with the following technologies to ensure scalable, high-performance applications:

Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Architecture frameworks: TOGAF, Zachmann, MODAF
Agile methodologies: SAFe, Scrum, Kanban
Modeling tools: UML, ArchiMate, Ardoq

What You Can Expect 🌱

Create and assure key architecture artefacts (e.g., Key Design Decision, Technical Options Paper, High Level Design)
Collaborate closely with Engineering teams, often taking a lead SME role to define vision and establish Architectural Guardrails.
Support senior leaders in shaping their case for change, leading on cost estimation and detailed planning.
Work to agile best practices and cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. You’ll be using your technical skills to problem solve with our clients, as well as working on internal projects
Hybrid working with the team on client site or in our office a minimum of two days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site.
An environment that deeply cares about its values

Qualifications

Essential requirements
✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

Hands-on Software Engineering background with experience leading engineering teams to deliver applications and services.
Clear understanding and practical application of architecture and delivery methodologies.
Operate confidently across all architectural domains with a specialism in at least one: Business, Data, Application, Technology, and Security.
Commitment to continuous improvement and professional development.
You thrive in problem-solving and analytical thinking
You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
Certifications in appropriate methodologies and cloud technologies are advantageous.

We’re technology agnostic, using the right tools for the job at hand, and you’ll have access to our strong partnerships with AWS, Azure and GCP. We’re interested to hear from Solution Architects with experience across the majority of leading vendors including Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle, IBM, Salesforce and more.

Additional Information

Assessment process ⚖️

Quick video call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a discussion around your client-centricity (45 mins)

Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work.

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

Find out more about Life at PA here.

We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits:

Health and lifestyle perks accompanying private healthcare for you and your family
25 days annual leave (plus a bonus half day on Christmas Eve) with the opportunity to buy 5 additional days
Generous company pension scheme
Opportunity to get involved with community and charity-based initiatives
Annual performance-based bonus
PA share ownership
Tax efficient benefits (cycle to work, give as you earn)

We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief veteran status, or other by any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups.

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior Developer in a self-organized Scrum team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain new features.
Take technical ownership of feature delivery, ensuring high quality, scalability, and performance.
Drive automation-first approach: design, implement, and maintain E2E, API, Integration tests.
Perform manual exploratory testing for complex scenarios.
Define test strategies at feature /module level.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development.
Contribute to architectural discussions and participate in technical decision-making
Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools.
Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code).
Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

What We Value

We are looking for an experienced engineer with well-developed technical and collaborative skills

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
5+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework).
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications in .NET / C#.
Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD
Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices.
Comprehensive understanding of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — 1Secure Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview 

We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core — providing unparalleled visibility and control.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services powering our enterprise SaaS security platform. You will work across a microservices architecture spanning ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, SQL Server, and Azure CosmosDB — shipping capabilities that serve Fortune 500 customers in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments at high scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where strong technical execution, distributed-systems fluency, and a security-first mindset are essential. You will independently own features and services end-to-end, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, multi-tenant solutions that meet enterprise and regulatory standards.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Service Development

Design and implement backend features end-to-end: from ASP.NET Core REST APIs and Azure Functions through to SQL Server and CosmosDB data layers.
Develop and extend .NET services within a microservices architecture composed of independently scalable, per-service function hosts.
Write and maintain Azure Functions for asynchronous processing workloads.
Build resilient, idempotent message-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus.

Data & Cloud Engineering

Work with SQL Server and Azure CosmosDB to implement performant, secure data access patterns at scale.
Own data access patterns that respect multi-tenant isolation boundaries and comply with security and privacy requirements, including RLS policy management.
Leverage Azure platform services including Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure App Configuration, Application Insights, and Entra ID integration.

Quality & DevOps

Write comprehensive backend tests: xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions for unit and integration coverage.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline maintenance using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerized local development (Docker Compose, Azurite).
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and technical debt across services.

Collaboration & Growth

Independently break down and deliver complex backend work, owning full project lifecycles from design through production.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions; enforce best practices across the codebase.
Partner with product managers and frontend/full-stack engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.
Champion the use of AI-driven approaches within the development process to enhance quality, speed, and innovation.

Qualifications  

6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend/distributed-systems focus.
Strong proficiency in **C# / .NET 8/10** (ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, isolated worker model).
Hands-on experience with **SQL Server** (T-SQL, Entity Framework Core, relational modelling, Row-Level Security) and at least one NoSQL database (CosmosDB preferred).
Experience building and operating **Azure-hosted** services (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, App Configuration, Application Insights).
Solid understanding of **authentication and authorization** patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Auth0 or similar identity providers).
Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS** architectures and the data isolation patterns they require.
Comfortable designing and debugging **asynchronous, message-driven systems** (queues, event-driven processing, idempotency, retries).
Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
Strong testing discipline (unit, integration) using xUnit/Moq/FluentAssertions or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to enterprise security domains (identity security, data security posture management, compliance).
Experience with **Azure CosmosDB** (SQL API and/or Gremlin graph API), including partitioning and throughput tuning.
Experience designing service boundaries in a **microservices architecture** with independent scaling and deployment.
Experience building compliance-ready products (e.g., SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 27001).

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
