Är du en erfaren konsult som brinner för att skapa välfungerande och optimerade molnlösningar? Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens digitalisering med hjälp av Cloud? Hos oss på Accigo får du vara med och stärka cloudaffären samtidigt som du utvecklar ditt självledarskap genom frihet under ansvar.

Vem är du?

Vi vill jobba med dig som vill vara med och bygga branschens starkaste affär och team inom Azure cloud consulting. Du drivs av teknisk utveckling samtidigt som du är en stjärna på att kommunicera på ett enkelt språk med kunder och kollegor. Du är lyhörd för kundens nuvarande behov och vågar samtidigt utmana befintliga arbetssätt och lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har

Flerårig erfarenhet av design och implementation av lösningar i Azure, inklusive god kännedom om Microsoft well architected framework & Cloud adoption framework.
Du har jobbat med on premises- eller hybrida system.
Du är bevandrad inom agilt arbetssätt och har stor kunskap av DevOps.
Kompetens inom Infrastructure as code (IaC) & PowerShell/CLI
Du har viss erfarenhet av att designa nätverk och tillhörande komponenter, i Azure och OnPrem.
Du har erfarenhet inom kravinsamling och presale-arbete
Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.
Gedigen erfarenhet som konsult där du jobbat med medelstora och stora bolag.

Ett plus om du har

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser
Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO — și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

SOLO este o companie de tehnologie care construiește produse folosite zilnic de zeci de mii de antreprenori din România.

Suntem într-o etapă în care AI-ul devine o componentă centrală în modul în care dezvoltăm produsul. Căutăm un inginer care vede AI-ul nu ca pe un tool auxiliar, ci ca pe o componentă de bază în construcția sistemelor.

Vei lucra la probleme reale, cu impact direct în produs, și vei contribui la modul în care integrăm AI în procesele noastre de dezvoltare în următorii ani.

Este un rol dificil, dar cu impact major asupra direcției tehnice a companiei.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei construi și livra funcționalități care ajung rapid în producție și sunt folosite de un număr mare de utilizatori.
Vei folosi AI pentru a automatiza fluxuri existente și pentru a construi sisteme noi — de la procese interne până la funcționalități direct în produs.
Vei contribui la decizii de arhitectură și la definirea modului în care folosim AI în dezvoltare. Nu există încă un playbook clar — o parte din rol este să îl construim.
Vei lucra direct cu fondatorii, CTO-ul și cu o echipă care pune accent pe simplitate, viteză de execuție și calitate.

Ce ne dorim de la tine

Ai experiență solidă ca software engineer (focus pe .NET) și poți livra constant într-un mediu cu ritm rapid.

Poți transforma probleme neclare în soluții funcționale, fără să depinzi de specificații perfecte.

Ești un power user real de AI. Scrii prompturi ca pe specificații tehnice. Ai construit sau cel puțin ai încercat să construiești un agent autonom, chiar și ca proiect personal de weekend.

Ai instincte bune despre când AI-ul e soluția și când nu e. Ești genul care citește release notes-urile OpenAI și Anthropic în ziua în care apar.

Comunici bine, colaborezi ușor și îți asumi responsabilitatea pentru ceea ce construiești.

Cultura noastră este orientată către performanță, energie și disciplină. Ne dorim colegi care împărtășesc un stil de viață sănătos, iar acest lucru nu este compatibil cu fumatul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (14.000 - 20.000 RON net, în funcție de nivel)
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim)
Program flexibil
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc) și buget de utilizare.
Lucrăm de la biroul nostru din București (Aviatorilor/Ch de Gaulle), pentru viteză și colaborare

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.

Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.

Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

Your Work Context

Are you an experienced Senior Software Developer D365 FSCM Engineer
with strong expertise in X++ and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (D365 F&SCM)
? This is your opportunity to join the central ICT team at Jan De Nul, based in Aalst, Belgium
. From our offices in Hofstade/Aalst, you will work on innovative, tailor-made solutions that support the core processes of a global organization.

In this role, you combine solid programming skills with in-depth knowledge of D365 F&SCM to build high-performing and scalable applications. You actively contribute to integrations, optimizations, and technical architectures within a dynamic ICT environment where quality, collaboration, and technological innovation are key.

Join our ICT team in Aalst and help shape future-proof digital solutions within a leading international company.

Your Role

At Jan De Nul, our ICT Development team plays a key role in supporting a wide range of dynamic business processes. Through both in-house developed and third-party software, we deliver tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs of the company.

As a Senior Software Developer D365 F&SCM Engineer within our FLOW ICT team you will focus on the technical side of building solutions in D365 F&SCM, going from implementing architecture design, programming, unit testing and ultimately delivering the solution towards our business users worldwide.

Your key Responsibilities:

Assist the Integration/Solution Architect in designing integrations between D365 applications and legacy/third party systems using multiple technologies, including X++, REST API, Power Automate, and MS SQL/Datalake/Dataverse.
Create SSRS reports
Provide feedback to improve and refine specifications.
Report to the Integration/Solution Architect and/or ICT Team lead on a regular basis with updates on progress, risks/challenges
Aid with regular quality audits related to D365 F&SCM
Write clean, structured, and testable code.
Understand performance implications of the development techniques to be used.
Follow established design principles, integration patterns, coding standards, and conventions.
Use modeling languages to understand and implement analyses.
Continuously build knowledge of the business domain and explore emerging technologies.
Deliver technical support for third-line incidents.

You will work from within our centralized ICT- team based in Belgium, Hofstade/Aalst where you can count on a stimulating work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package — including the option to lease a company car.

What do you need?

As Software Developer, you are passionate about coding and bring a strong foundation in computer science — either through a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

You have at least five years of professional experience in object-oriented programming (X++, D365 FSCM is a must). Creating reports with SSRS is considered as a plus.

You have solid expertise in X++, and RESTful web services using ASP.NET Web API. You are also proficient in SQL and stored procedures.

Understanding of security design principles for both D365 F&SCM and Azure components, including the mechanisms for authorization and interaction with these components

You possess a good knowledge and can speak fluently in Dutch, considered as a prerequisite for this role

Working at Jan De Nul

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day, with the aim of ensuring the global quality of life for generations to come. 

What We Offer

Through the JDN Academy, we offer you an ongoing training path.
Through our FIT program, we watch over your well-being with attention to exercise, nutrition and various team activities.
A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional work from home).
An open-ended contract with 42 paid vacations (20 statutory, 12 ADV and 10 public holidays).
An attractive salary with thirteenth month and double vacation pay included:
Meal vouchers and eco vouchers.
Possibility to participate in the Flex Reward program containing bicycle and car leasing including fuel card in Belgium.
Group and hospitalization insurance.
Option of iPhone with telephony and data subscription (subject to contribution).
Various employee discounts.

You become part of an internationally growing family business.

The world becomes what you make of it. 
Jan De Nul is shaping water and land around the world. We drive the transition to renewable energy with offshore energy infrastructure. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build ports and protect our coastline. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and sustainable buildings. And we redevelop our planet by giving polluted sites a new purpose. At Jan De Nul, the world becomes what you make of it.   

Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and against discrimination.

Voor onze Primary Care afdeling (Huisartsen en Thuiszorg) zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Application Architect om het ontwerp, implementatie en de architectuur van een van onze SaaS-producten te helpen uitbouwen. Je zult deel uitmaken van 1 van onze engineering teams, en verantwoordelijk zijn voor het ontwerpen en helpen implementeren van 1 of meerdere functionele domeinen binnen onze producten. Als Application Architect zorg je ook voor de groei en goede werking van het team, je volgt de developers op, helpt met coachen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en helpt het team efficiënt werken. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Architectuur Team, dat over de teams heen zorgt voor een consistente aanpak en waar de overkoepelende architectuur beslissingen worden genomen.

Technisch Leiderschap: Geef strategische richting voor het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en implementatie van features, waarbij hoge beschikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en beveiliging worden gegarandeerd.

Evaluatie van de Technologie Stack: Selecteer en evalueer technologieën, frameworks en tools om ervoor te zorgen dat ze in lijn zijn met de behoeften van het product, de technische doelen en de best practices binnen de industrie.
Hands-on development: Werk binnen een engineering team om de code architectuur, kwaliteit en design te bewaken. Lead by example: je ontwikkelt actief mee aan features en coached de rest van het team
Deployment Architecture: Ontwerp de applicatie-implementatie architectuur voor services, APIs en integraties, waardoor een modulaire en losgekoppelde architectuur wordt mogelijk gemaakt die hergebruik en snelle implementatie bevordert.
Security and Compliance: Implementeer beveiliging volgens de security by design-principes, waarbij wordt gegarandeerd dat het platform voldoet aan industriestandaarden zoals GDPR, SOC 2 en andere compliance vereisten.
Performance Optimization: Zorg ervoor dat de architectuur hoge beschikbaarheid, lage latentie en efficiënt gebruik van middelen ondersteunt, en streef naar continue verbetering.
Documentatie en normen: Zorg ervoor dat architecturale documentatie geschreven en up-to-date gehouden wordt en stel normen op voor ontwikkelingsteams om consistentie en kwaliteit te waarborgen.

Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met ten minste 4 jaar in een software architect-rol gericht op SaaS-producten.

Ervaring in de gezondheidszorg wordt als een pluspunt beschouwd.
Expertise in moderne programmeertalen zoals Java en idealiter Golang. Ervaring met Java en Spring Boot, en ervaring met Golang wordt als een groot pluspunt beschouwd.

Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische belanghebbenden.
A can-do mentality: Je stelt oplossingen voor in plaats van problemen aan te kaarten en je kan actief mee in de code duiken
Je hebt ervaring binnen grotere omgevingen, waar er meerdere teams samen werken aan hetzelfde product.

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

We are looking for a software engineer to build the cloud-native and full-stack systems that power customer-facing simulation at Skydio. In this role, you will design and implement the services, APIs, and interfaces that allow customers to configure, personalize, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.

This is not a pure cloud role: you will work closely with the simulator itself, interfacing directly with C++ and Python systems that run real-time simulation and autonomy software. You’ll help bridge the gap between a complex robotics simulator and intuitive, flexible user experiences delivered through the cloud.

Areas Of Responsibility

Cloud-Backed Simulation Services: Build backend systems that orchestrate simulator execution, configuration, and lifecycle management in cloud environments.
Customer Personalization and Configuration: Enable customers to tailor simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors through robust APIs and services.
Simulator Integration: Design clean, reliable interfaces between cloud services and the core simulator runtime, including control, data exchange, and monitoring.
Full-Stack Experiences: Develop backend and frontend components that expose simulator capabilities through web interfaces and customer-facing tools.
Scalability and Reliability: Ensure simulation services are secure, observable, and scalable to support production customer workloads.

What You’ll Do

Design and build cloud-native services that orchestrate, configure, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.
Develop robust backend systems that interface directly with the simulator runtime, enabling control, configuration, data exchange, and monitoring.
Build customer-facing workflows and APIs that allow users to personalize simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors.
Implement full-stack features, collaborating across backend services and frontend applications to deliver intuitive, reliable simulation experiences.
Partner closely with simulator, autonomy, and product teams to translate complex simulator capabilities into usable, production-ready customer features.
Architect systems with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and security, supporting multi-tenant, production workloads.
Contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions around how simulation is delivered as a cloud product.

Qualifications

Strong professional experience building backend and distributed systems in production environments.
Proficiency in Python and C++ (required), with the ability to integrate cloud services with performance-sensitive native systems.
Proficiency in modern frontend development using TypeScript and React.
Experience designing and consuming APIs, including GraphQL or similar API paradigms.
Experience with cloud and platform technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.
Comfort working across system boundaries — from cloud services and APIs down to simulator-facing interfaces.
Strong product sense and ability to design systems that are both technically sound and intuitive for customers.
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams and disciplines.

Bonus Experience

Experience with Go for backend or platform services.
Experience with Rust (strong plus), especially for systems, performance-sensitive, or infrastructure work.
Frontend experience with 3D or visualization technologies such as Three.js or WebGL.
Familiarity with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal.
Experience productizing complex technical systems for external users.
Background or interest in simulation, robotics, or real-time systems.

Location: Graz, Austria

Job ID: 45577

Are you a motivated student who wants to code, test, and innovate instead of doing repetitive tasks? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technology where your ideas matter from day one? Then you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

At HID Global in Graz, we’re a young and dynamic team working at the forefront of identity, privacy protection, and access control. Testing isn’t an afterthought for us—it’s where innovation starts.

You’ll be part of the HID Identity Technologies Lab, helping to shape Seos technology inside smart devices and across global ecosystems.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

You’ll dive into everything from mutation testing, data fuzzing, and stress testing to connecting Jenkins with real hardware and automating robots. From low-level protocol debugging to user experience testing, you’ll explore the full spectrum of modern software quality engineering.

Your Experience and Background include:

Experience in object-oriented programming (C# / .NET / .NET Core)
Test case architecture, specification, and implementation
Interest in test automation (Jenkins, scripting languages)
Align and develop a common test framework, common libraries, code coverage tools, reporting UI frameworks
Eager to learn DevOps skills and common frameworks/tools
Understanding of low-level hardware communication protocols
ISTQB certification or other test certification (can be acquired online)
Experience with Secure Elements, RFID, NFC, HCE or BLE technologies
Working knowledge of cryptography and security practices

What we can offer you:

Competitive salary and rewards package
Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply

Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted

HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact accommodations-ext@hidglobal.com .

Please be aware that our recruitment process may include the use of AI-powered tools to assist in screening applicant resumes. We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. You’ll be a key voice in evolving our engineering practices and will actively champion the use of AI-powered tools to streamline development, improve quality, and boost team productivity.

We’re looking for someone who is not only passionate about building great software but also excited to explore how AI can unlock better ways of working for themselves and their teammates.

Design and own secure, scalable services, guiding technical decisions and evaluating trade-offs (including AI-driven components) to meet reliability, performance, and cost goals.

Support and guide migrations from existing container platforms onto AKS.

Define SLO/SLI-based monitoring and alerting for critical services.
Design and operate Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent SIEM platforms.

Build and maintain Terraform and/or Bicep for platform components, including reusable modules, remote state, environment promotion and drift detection.
Deliver infrastructure through automated CI/CD pipelines.
Establish IaC and policy-as-code standards using technologies such as Azure Policy, Checkov and tfsec.
Automate operational processes using PowerShell, Bash or Python.

Production experience architecting and operating Kubernetes/AKS, including networking, security hardening and upgrades.

Sluit je aan bij ons team en draag bij aan uitdagende projecten die organisaties helpen hun digitale ambities te realiseren.

Jouw bijdrage aan de reis

Als F&O Developer werk je aan projecten bij nationale en internationale klanten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van maatwerkoplossingen, het verbeteren van processen en het vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar technische oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met consultants en projectteams om oplossingen te leveren die aansluiten bij de specifieke behoeften van de klant.

Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van maatwerkoplossingen in Dynamics 365 F&O
Samenwerken met consultants en business experts om processen te verbeteren
Meedenken over technische oplossingen en deze vertalen naar de praktijk
Werken in uitdagende projecten bij diverse klanten, van ontwerp tot implementatie
Kennisdelen binnen het team en bijdragen aan een professionele samenwerking

Je komt in een gedreven team van F&O professionals dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt. Binnen de UO & F&O-unit krijg je de kans om je technische kennis te verdiepen, projecten te leiden en jezelf continu te ontwikkelen via workshops, trainingen en certificeringen.

Wat neem jij mee?

Ervaring met C# development, bij voorkeur in de context van Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O. Als je geen F&O ervaring hebt, maar wel 3-5 jaar ervaring met C#, voel je dan vooral vrij om ook te reageren;

Proactieve houding en het vermogen om mee te denken in een team ;

Bedrijfsfeesten, sportactiviteiten en wekelijkse borrels om onze gezamenlijke reis te versterken.   

Onze wereldwijde route

Als Microsoft Inner Circle-partner en internationaal opererend bedrijf biedt HSO jou toegang tot best practices, certificeringen en een wereldwijd netwerk van experts. Samen met ruim 2200 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen. jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Solution Architect Expert

Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen

Bij de Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen geloven we in een toekomst waarin zorg menselijker, slimmer en efficiënter is. En daar werken we elke dag met veel goesting
aan.

Onze Landsbond telt meer dan 1.000 gemotiveerde medewerkers die samen één doel delen: de gezondheidszorg van morgen vormgeven. Drie ziekenfondsen maken deel uit van onze groep: Partenamut, Helan en de Freie Krankenkasse. Samen staan we paraat voor meer dan 2,3 miljoen leden.

Bij ons krijg je geen gewone job, maar een ZINvolle uitdaging.
We zetten complexe vraagstukken om in concrete, haalbare en slimme oplossingen. Vrij en onafhankelijk van politieke of religieuze banden streven we elke dag weer naar de beste service voor onze leden.

Onze medewerkers bruisen van talent, kennis en initiatief.
Ze nemen hun carrière in eigen handen en denken mee over hoe het beter kan. Die gedrevenheid en flexibiliteit maken ons sterk.

Respect, ondernemerschap en resultaatgerichtheid vormen de basis van onze cultuur. We geloven in flexibel werken, in tijd én in ruimte. Moderne kantoren en een open sfeer maken het plaatje compleet.

Klaar om je talenten in te zetten voor zorg die mensen vooruithelpt? Ontdek onze vacatures en groei met ons mee.

Ontdek onze vacatures op www.mloz.be

Functieomschrijving

Als Solution Architect draag je bij aan het ontwerpen van het IT-landschap van de organisatie op basis van de business-strategie. Je fungeert als de belangrijkste schakel tussen de business en IT voor strategische initiatieven en bent ook de technische leider van een transversale squad die verantwoordelijk is voor een portfolio van kritieke businesstoepassingen.

Je komt bij een team dat momenteel bestaat uit een product owner, een scrum master, een analist en een ontwikkelaar. In deze rol leg je de technische visie vast, stuur je architecturale beslissingen aan, mentor je teamleden en waarborg je de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van de oplossingen die onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid vallen.

Een bijzondere uitdaging van deze positie is dat de squad meer dan 40 kritieke businesstoepassingen beheert, inclusief verschillende legacy systemen en moderne, op Azure gebaseerde, oplossingen. Je moet in staat zijn om aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te werken en daarbij de operationele stabiliteit waarborgen en de lopende transformatie-initiatieven ondersteunen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Betrokkenheid bij de ontwikkeling van projecten

Helpen businessbehoeften en -vereisten in kaart brengen tijdens workshops en ontdekkingssessies.
Verschillende oplossingsopties evalueren en de meest geschikte architectuur aanbevelen op basis van de business-strategie, architecturale principes, kosten, risico’s en overgangsplannen.
Oplossingsarchitecturen definiëren, documenteren en communiceren aan belanghebbenden uit zowel de business als de IT, en de bijbehorende architecturale modellen en documentatie opstellen en bijhouden.
De gevolgen en onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen bestaande toepassingen, lopende projecten en toekomstige initiatieven identificeren, en prioritering binnen de roadmap van de organisatie ondersteunen.
Businessvereisten omzetten in haalbare technische oplossingen en implementeringsroadmaps.
Bijdragen aan discussies over technisch ontwerp, en ontwikkelingsstandaarden en beste praktijken vaststellen.
Ondersteuning bieden bij financiële prognoses, het inschatten van de benodigde inspanningen, het identificeren van risico’s en het opstellen van plannen voor risicobeperking.

Technische Leiderschap

Optreden als de technische leider van de squad en advies geven over architecturale en technische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelaars en andere teamleden coachen, mentoren en ondersteunen in het versterken van hun technische expertise.
Beste praktijken voor software engineering, codekwaliteit, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid bevorderen.
Technische reviews leiden en ervoor zorgen dat de architecturale standaarden worden nageleefd.
Het oplossen en verhelpen van complexe technische kwesties in het volledige toepassingenlandschap ondersteunen.
Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen het team aansturen.

Profiel kandidaat

Ervaring en opleiding

Masterdiploma in computerwetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior ontwikkelaar, of een gelijkaardige rol, idealiter in complexe bedrijfsomgevingen.
Ervaring met agile en SAFe-omgevingen; ervaring in de verzekeringssector, gezondheidszorg of andere sterk gereguleerde sectoren is een grote troef.
Frans of Nederlands is vereist, met een zeer goed begrip van de andere taal, alsook een uitstekende beheersing van het Engels.

Technische Vaardigheden

Uitstekende kennis van oplossings- en integratiearchitectuur, met een sterke achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling en levenscyclusbeheer van toepassingen.
Sterke ervaring met .NET/C# en uitgebreide kennis van JavaScript/TypeScript, inclusief Angular en Single Page Applications (SPA).
Hoge bekwaamheid in Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL en T-SQL.
Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure-diensten, cloud-native architecturen en REST API’s; ervaring met Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event-driven Architecture of Azure PaaS is een groot voordeel.
Ervaring met het implementeren van DevOps-praktijken en CI/CD-pipelines, met een sterk begrip van Git; vertrouwdheid met Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker en containerisatie is een pluspunt.
Kennis van ArchiMate, BPMN en UML (certificering is een troef).
Ervaring met kostenramingen, risicobeheer en technische governance.

Niet-technische profielvereisten

Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde en georganiseerde aanpak.
Het vermogen om verschillende projecten en prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren, en om zelfstandig te werken met beperkt toezicht.
Een resultaat- en klantgerichte instelling, met een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een sterke teamgeest.
Uitstekende vaardigheden op het gebied van interpersoonlijke communicatie en het omgaan met stakeholders, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten over te brengen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen.

Een solidaire organisatie waar het fijn werken is
Een moderne werkomgeving, in een toegankelijke groene omgeving, ongeacht je favoriete vervoerswijze
Een goed evenwicht tussen privéleven en werk, met flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen per week thuis te werken
Initiatieven die het welzijn bevorderen en de onderlinge band versterken: yoga, padel, inspirerende workshops, filmavonden, seizoensgebonden drinks, rondetafelgesprekken in het Nederlands of Frans, …
Een plek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en gelijke kansen krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen
Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket

Toegang tot het Flexible Income Plan waarmee je zelf je loonpakket kan beheren in functie van je behoeften en je situatie
Talrijke extralegale voordelen, zoals aansluiting bij Dentalia Up en Hospitalia Plus, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, groepsverzekering en een gsm

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
At Suitsupply, we combine radical style with radical technology. We are looking for a Principal Engineer — the most senior hands-on engineer in the company: you design, you build, and you ship alongside our teams. You set the engineering standard for an entire domain, and you make it stick — in the code, in the pipelines, and in how our teams adopt AI-native ways of working. Expect a roughly 50/50 split: half your time accelerating projects inside teams, half driving the cross-cutting standards everyone works to.

What you will do:

Set the standard: own the cross-cutting standards backlog for your domains — unified observability and monitoring, alerting, release and deployment processes, CI/CD templates, and shared packages — and make them binding: non-compliant code does not merge.
Stay in the code: design, prototype and build on the hardest cross-team problems — the migrations, integrations and foundations no single team can own.
Jump-start delivery: parachute into projects that need momentum — run the technical discovery, shape the solution, get the first implementation moving with the team. You accelerate teams.
Embed, don't tower: work inside teams to raise the bar in place, pairing with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers.
Enforce through systems: skills-per-repo, PR guardrails and automated checks carry the standard, so it scales without you hand-reviewing every merge.
Make us AI-native: drive agentic development as the default way of working, on a drumbeat you set with the Engineering Managers.
Cover the gaps: step into teams without a Tech Lead to keep delivery and quality on track while we hire.
Pair at the top: partner with Engineering Leadership on domain architecture. You set the standard; the Tech Leads spread it.

Who you are:

10+ years of engineering, with recent staff- or principal-level scope at a strong product or tech company.
You have carried technical responsibility across at least three domains — not one deep silo. This is a hard requirement.
You have joined an existing ecosystem and changed it — change management in a landscape you didn't build is core to this job; greenfield-only track records don't clear the bar.
Hands-on across the stack and still shipping code weekly; deep in at least one of .NET and Azure event-driven backends, large-scale commerce ecosystems, or integration and data platforms.
You have made standards stick across teams that didn't report to you — through tooling, guardrails and example, not decks.
Already ahead of us on AI-assisted and agentic development at enterprise scale — multi-team, inside an existing ecosystem. We expect to learn this from you, not to teach it to you — and you can show a team or codebase you made measurably faster.
You explain hard things simply — to engineers, to product, to the board. If you truly know it, you can say it plainly.
Zero direct reports, by design — and that suits you. Your authority is technical, and on domain standards it is final.

What you will get:

Competitive compensation — we benchmark this role against the top of the Dutch tech market, not against retail. A freelance-first start is possible if that is how you work.
A real top-of-ladder IC seat: final say on domain standards, a direct line to the Head of Engineering and the Director, and no management detour required to keep growing.
Scale that shows: ~16 product teams, a global Shopify migration, own-built Custom Made and Radical Personal platforms, and an ERP transition — with the mandate to make it all AI-native.
Autonomy without layers of sign-off
Hybrid working: three days in the Amsterdam HQ, two remote — flexible in both directions once you're up to speed.
A 40% discount on Suitsupply product, and a working wardrobe you'll actually want to wear.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Solution Architect Expert

Mutualités Libres

Aux Mutualités Libres, nous croyons en un avenir avec des soins plus humains, plus intelligents et plus efficaces. Et nous y travaillons chaque jour avec envie
.

Notre Union compte plus de 1.000 collaborateurs motivés qui partagent un même objectif : façonner les soins de santé de demain. Trois mutualités font partie de notre groupe : Partenamut, Helan et la Freie Krankenkasse. Ensemble, nous assurons plus de 2,3 millions de membres.

Nous ne proposons pas un simple job, mais un défi significatif
. Nous transformons des questions complexes en solutions concrètes, réalisables et intelligentes. Libres et indépendants de toute affiliation politique ou religieuse, nous nous efforçons chaque jour d’offrir le meilleur service à nos membres.

Nos collaborateurs débordent de talent, de connaissances et d'initiative.
Ils prennent leur carrière en main et réfléchissent à des propositions d'amélioration. Ce dynamisme et cette flexibilité font notre force.

Le respect, l’entrepreneuriat et l'orientation résultats constituent la base de notre culture. Nous croyons en la flexibilité du travail, dans le temps et dans l'espace. Des bureaux modernes et une atmosphère ouverte complètent le tableau.

Vous êtes prêt à mettre vos talents au service de soins qui font progresser ? Découvrez nos offres d'emploi et évoluez avec nous: www.mloz.be

Functieomschrijving

En tant que Solution Architect, vous contribuerez à la conception du paysage IT de l’organisation sur la base de la stratégie business. Vous servirez de lien principal entre le business et l’IT pour les initiatives stratégiques, tout en assumant le rôle de leader technique d’une squad transversale chargée d’un portefeuille d’applications business critiques.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe actuellement composée d’un Product Owner, d’un Scrum Master, d’un analyste et d’un développeur. Dans ce rôle, vous serez chargé de définir la vision technique, d’orienter les décisions architecturales, d’encadrer les membres de l’équipe et de garantir la pérennité à long terme des solutions relevant de votre responsabilité.

L’un des défis particuliers de ce poste réside dans le fait que la squad gère plus de 40 applications business critiques, dont plusieurs systèmes hérités et des solutions modernes basées sur Azure. Vous devrez être en mesure de travailler sur plusieurs projets tout en garantissant la stabilité opérationnelle et en soutenant les initiatives de transformation en cours.

Tâches et responsabilités

Implication dans le développement de projets

Contribuer à la formulation des besoins et des exigences métier lors d’ateliers et de sessions de découverte.
Évaluer différentes options de solution et recommander l’architecture la plus appropriée sur la base de la stratégie métier, des principes architecturaux, des coûts, des risques et des plans de transition
Définir, documenter et communiquer les architectures de solution aux parties prenantes business et IT, et mettre en place et maintenir les modèles architecturaux et la documentation associés.
Identifier les impacts et les dépendances entre les applications existantes, les projets en cours et les initiatives futures, et contribuer à la hiérarchisation des priorités dans le cadre de la feuille de route de l’organisation.
Traduire les exigences métier en solutions techniques concrètes et en feuilles de route d’implémentation.
Participer aux discussions sur la conception technique et établir des normes de développement ainsi que des bonnes pratiques.
Contribuer aux prévisions financières, à l’estimation des efforts, à l’identification des risques et à la planification des mesures d’atténuation.

Leadership technique

Assumer le rôle de responsable technique de la squad et fournir des conseils sur les décisions architecturales et techniques.
Coacher, encadrer et soutenir les développeurs et les autres membres de l'équipe afin de renforcer leur expertise technique.
Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie logicielle, qualité du code, sécurité, maintenabilité et évolutivité.
Diriger les revues techniques et veiller au respect des normes architecturales.
Contribuer au dépannage et à la résolution des problèmes techniques complexes au sein de l'ensemble du paysage applicatif.
Piloter des initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein de l'équipe

Profiel kandidaat

Expérience et formation

Master en informatique ou équivalent par expérience.
Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior Developer ou dans un poste similaire, de préférence dans des environnements d’entreprise complexes.
Expérience dans des environnements Agile et SAFe ; une expérience dans les secteurs de l’assurance, des soins de santé ou d’autres secteurs fortement réglementés constitue un atout majeur.
Français ou néerlandais requis, avec une très bonne compréhension de l’autre langue, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais.

Compétences techniques

Excellente connaissance en architecture d’intégration et de solution, avec une solide expérience en développement logiciel et en gestion du cycle de vie des applications.
Solide expérience avec .NET/C# et connaissance approfondie de JavaScript/TypeScript, notamment Angular et les applications monopages (SPA).
Maîtrise approfondie de Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL et T-SQL.
Expérience pratique des services Microsoft Azure, des architectures cloud natives et des REST API ; une expérience avec Azure Functions, Logic Apps, l’architecture orientée événements ou Azure PaaS constitue un atout majeur.
Expérience dans l’implémentation de pratiques DevOps et de pipelines CI/CD, avec une solide compréhension de Git ; la maîtrise de l’« Infrastructure as Code », d’Azure DevOps Pipelines, de Docker et de la conteneurisation est un atout.
Connaissance d’ArchiMate, de BPMN et d’UML (une certification est un atout).
Expérience en estimation des coûts, en gestion des risques et en gouvernance technique.

Exigences non techniques relatives au profil

Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, associée à une approche structurée et organisée.
Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets et priorités, en travaillant de manière autonome avec un encadrement limité.
Esprit axé sur les résultats et orienté client, avec un sens aigu des responsabilités et un fort esprit d'équipe.
Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes, notamment la capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des publics tant techniques que non techniques.

Dein zukünftiges Team

Du bringst ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein mit und verstehst nachhaltige Softwareentwicklung, Testautomatisierung und moderne Architekturprinzipien nicht als Zusatz, sondern als Grundlage guter Engineering-Arbeit. Du arbeitest in einem unserer agilen Teams – nach Scrum oder Kanban – und bringst dein technisches Know-how aktiv in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen ein. Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du entwickelst moderne Webanwendungen auf Basis von C#/.NET und Vue.js und begleitest den gesamten Software Development Lifecycle
Als Fullstack Engineer arbeitest du im Frontend, Backend, an Datenbanken und APIs und gestaltest die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform aktiv mit
Du entwickelst Lösungen für komplexe fachliche Anforderungen im Healthcare-Bereich und setzt moderne Architekturprinzipien wie Domain-Driven Design, CQRS und Event Sourcing ein
Qualität ist für dich integraler Bestandteil guter Software: TDD, Unit Tests, Code Reviews und automatisierte Qualitätssicherung gehören für dich selbstverständlich dazu

Mithilfe von OpenTelemetry und modernen Observability-Lösungen stellst du Transparenz, Monitoring und Traceability über den gesamten Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozess sicher
Perspektivisch übernimmst du mehr Verantwortung in Architekturfragen und gestaltest skalierbare, zukunftsfähige Systemlandschaften mit

Das sind deine Stärken & Skills

Du bist als Fullstack Developer vertraut mit modernen Webtechnologien, insbesondere Vue.js, HTML, CSS sowie JavaScript/TypeScript
Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwarearchitekturen sowie von DDD, CQRS und idealerweise Event Sourcing
Du bringst Erfahrung mit SQL Server, REST APIs, CI/CD, Containerisierung sowie Cloud- und DevOps-Praktiken mit
Softwarequalität, Testautomatisierung und nachhaltige Entwicklung sind fester Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

As a Senior Engineer at DeepL, you will operate with the agency of a founder. You will join a high-performance engineering culture that values shipping speed, system reliability, and direct business impact over theoretical perfection, whether you are building our next-gen Voice API, architecting our massive billing engine, or scaling our core product platform, you will own your domain end-to-end.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Outcome, Not Just the Code: You will move beyond "implementing specs." You will own revenue-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged .
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions (monolith vs. microservice, consistency vs. availability) with incomplete information. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you identify risks, build prototypes, and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Bridge the Gap: You will be bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will translate complex technical constraints (latency, eventual consistency) into business terms for Product Managers, ensuring we negotiate the right trade-offs to ship value faster .
Drive Technical Pragmatism: You will avoid "Resume-Driven Development." Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Python, Kubernetes, React) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends.

Qualities we look for

A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that survive 10x growth.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a fire, you put it out. If the documentation is missing, you write it. You are comfortable unblocking yourself and the team in a fast-paced environment .
Product Fluency: You care deeply about the user. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You have a track record of shipping features that solve real business problems.
Polyglot & Adaptable: While experience with C#/.NET Core or React is a bonus, we value engineers who can pick up the right tool for the job. You are comfortable traversing the full stack, from the database lock to the UI state.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Manager | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Technology Consulting | Belfast

In Digital Engineering we shape, concept and build innovative solutions that address the most important issues and opportunities for our clients. Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams addressing some of most significant issues facing society today, such as transition to sustainable energy, digitisation of government, scaling high-growth businesses, exploiting the potential of AI and improving wellness with digital healthcare.

The core capabilities of our team include:

Digital strategy, horizon scanning, and strategic planning. Working in combined teams with Business Designers, Researchers, Strategists, Industry and Functional Specialists, we develop a vision, roadmap and case for change to address fundamental issues facing our clients, such as “how can we grow?”, “how do we respond to disruption?” and “what can we do next?”
Digital technology delivery management. Using principles of lean start-up and agile, we manage large-scale delivery programmes that include custom software and SaaS solutions, using an ecosystem of EY, client and partner agency resources. We have a range of skills across programme management, solution architecture, product management, business analysis and delivery management,
Digital software engineering. Many of our solutions involve custom engineering of unique solutions and experiences created from modern web-scale technologies, including SPAs, JavaScript, Microservices, Cloud Computing and Machine Learning.

As a technologist in Digital Engineering, EY offers you the opportunity to apply your skills in a highly strategic context, working on meaningful and impactful solutions that build a better working world. EY is a leader in Business Transformation services, and the Digital Engineering team is rapidly growing to enable us to deliver more of our technology work. This is an exciting time for new joiners who will have many opportunities to make their mark on the business and accelerate their personal and professional growth.

The opportunity

EY is actively growing our Digital Engineering team in Belfast and is expanding our engineering capability. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly capable developer who is ready to operate at a senior level, combining hands-on delivery with technical leadership, mentorship, and ownership of complex systems. We are looking for someone who is ready to challenge themselves by learning new technologies, lead developer teams and understand a product from end to end.

Your Key Responsibilities

Actively participate and own the design, development and delivery of full stack products from frontend to backend.
Build and maintain responsive, high-quality user interfaces using modern frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue.
Design and implement robust APIs and services, ensuring security, reliability and maintainability.
Work closely with product teams to understand complex business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Present delivered features and technical solutions confidently to stakeholders and clients.
Perform thorough peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and maintaining high engineering standards.
Support and lead non-functional improvements, including technical debt reduction, performance optimisation and creation of clear API documentation.
Play a key role in defining the engineering strategy for Digital Engineering, advocating for consistent standards, practices and approaches across teams and client engagements.
Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong professional full-stack development experience, with increasing levels of responsibility.
Strong backend development experience using Node.js, Java, Python, .NET or similar technologies.
Proven ability to design and build scalable APIs and distributed systems.
Solid experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Experience with testing frameworks, unit testing, integration testing and automated testing strategies.
Strong understanding of software development best practices, system design, maintainability and code quality.
Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams and contributing to delivery planning and estimation.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, CI/CD pipelines or DevOps practices would be beneficial.
Exposure to NoSQL databases, microservices or event-driven architectures would be desirable.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Strong technical decision-making ability.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to challenges.
Confident communicator, able to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mentor mindset with a passion for developing others and raising team capability.
High level of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

What We Look For

We’re interested in candidates who can take end-to-end ownership of complex features and systems, balancing hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You should bring a strong voice in shaping our engineering culture in Belfast and the wider Digital Engineering capability. You will influence how the team builds, delivers and scales software, with a proven ability to improve code quality, team processes and system architecture. If you’re serious about joining Digital Engineering and ready to help deliver meaningful, scalable solutions for our clients, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, OPS Data Transfer, Integration & Quality to join our team. This role is located in Manchester, UK.

How You’ll Make An Impact

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Acts as a senior RPA UiPath Developer responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting automation solutions across Wealth Services Operations.
Works closely with Business SMEs, Operations teams, and Engineering partners to understand business requirements and deliver scalable automation solutions.
Provides technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing automation solutions that are efficient, controlled, reusable, and aligned to business requirements.
Supports operations with a data-first and automation-first approach to proactively identify process improvement opportunities.
Delivers meaningful change for the operation by building digital tools, UiPath automations, API-enabled solutions, and AI-enabled automation capabilities.
Ensures automation solutions are reliable, secure, well-documented, and suitable for production use by business users.
Acts as a technical partner for the platform group by supporting process assessment, solution design, development standards, and production readiness.

In This Role, You’ll Oversee The Below Tasks:

Delivery
Collaborate with Business SMEs, Operations users, and Technology partners to understand business needs, assess automation feasibility, and deliver scalable UiPath automation solutions.
Plan, prioritize and deliver assigned automation work items in line with agreed timelines, business priorities, quality standards, and production readiness requirements.
Requirements / Stories
Gather, analyze and convert business requirements into clear process documentation, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical design inputs.
Validate requirements with cross-functional stakeholders to identify process gaps, control risks, dependencies, exception scenarios, and opportunities for process improvement.
Development / Technical Implementation
Design and develop automation workflows using UiPath Studio, reusable components, UiPath Orchestrator capabilities, and structured exception handling.
Build automation solutions across Excel, Outlook, web applications, desktop applications, SharePoint, APIs, PDFs, and internal business systems, including AI-enabled automation opportunities where applicable.
Testing / Implementation
Perform unit testing, support system testing and user acceptance testing, and review test results to ensure outcomes meet the defined acceptance criteria.
Analyze testing failures to identify defects, missed requirements, process gaps, or additional exception scenarios before production implementation.
Production / Operational Readiness
Support production deployment, release readiness, run books, support documentation, and handover activities.
Monitor production automations, troubleshoot failures using logs and exception reports, and support defect fixes, enhancements, and change requests.
Process Improvement / AI Enablement
Partner with Operations teams to identify opportunities for process simplification, risk reduction, efficiency improvement, and automation expansion.
Support the use of AI capabilities such as document understanding, intelligent extraction, AI-assisted development, and agentic automation solutions to improve business outcomes.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Technical skills:
UiPath, VB/C#.net/Python
Experience in API, SQL, building Attended and unattended Automations.
Demonstrable AI expertise and additional tools like Power Automate, Alteryx, Power BI is an advantage.

Desired - business acumen / knowledge of:
Wealth Management, Wealth Services and Transfers of ISAs and other EMEA investment wrappers
Wealth product knowledge

Research skills
Critical thinking skills
Stakeholder management: Should have strong experience in managing senior stakeholders as part of Projects.
Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills required.

Danfoss Group IT is seeking an experienced developer
to forefront our integration initiatives and drive the continued improvement of our application portfolio in Azure cloud.
In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust and scalable enterprise-level integrations.

You will be part of the Digital Customer Experience (DCE) team, with more than 125 international colleagues, where we develop, support, and lead the digital customer experience in Danfoss. We connect business needs and IT into digital solutions.

Design and implement event-driven integrations (Azure Event Grid and Azure Service Bus) and serverless functions following MACH principles.
Utilizing Azure CDN to serve assets and ensure the best possible user experience.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Bicep.
Ensure adherence to Microsoft Azure security best practices and industry standards including access controls, data encryption, and vulnerability management.
Establish and maintain a robust CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.

Proven professional experience in Azure integration technologies, including Azure Functions, Azure Event Grid, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management.
Strong proficiency in .NET development and C#.
Solid understanding of serverless architectures and cloud-native principles.
Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep or Terraform.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Azure DevOps.
Deep knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.

Proficiency in spoken and written English.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled full stack Software Engineer
with deep expertise in .NET development and data-driven applications
to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain enterprise solutions that support Agilent's scientific instruments, laboratory management systems, and business intelligence initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets. You will leverage modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and analytics tools to build scalable applications, data pipelines, and dashboards that drive informed business decisions and deliver value to customers.

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using .NET Core/.NET Framework and AWS services.
Build scalable and secure APIs, backend services, and data-driven applications.
Develop responsive user interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Analyze, process, and manage large and complex datasets from multiple data sources.
Design and implement data models, ETL processes, and integrations that ensure data quality, reliability, and performance.
Leverage modern data platforms and analytics solutions to generate actionable business insights and support organizational objectives.
Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
Collaborate with product owners, architects, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and cloud-native development practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, data issues, and production incidents.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Framework, and .NET Core.
Strong experience designing and developing data-centric applications.
Experience with enterprise databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Hands-on experience with ETL and data integration tools such as SSIS, AWS Glue, or similar technologies.
Experience building and maintaining reporting solutions using SSRS, Power BI, QuickSight, or comparable analytics platforms.
Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS, and cloud-based data solutions.
Proficiency with modern web development frameworks.
Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Strong understanding of software design patterns, object-oriented design, and best practices.
Experience with source control systems such as Git.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Experience with microservices architecture and domain-driven design.
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with NGRX, RxJS, NX, and Micro-Frontend architectures.
Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, or AI-driven solutions. Familiarity with AI assisted coding is a plus.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Software Engineer is part of the Program & Performance Management team within the Manufacturing Competence Center (MCC), supporting digitalization initiatives for manufacturing operations.

Under the guidance of the Senior Software Engineer, this role contributes to the development, maintenance, and support of software solutions within the scope of Industry 4.0 and digital transformation, while building strong technical foundations and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to deliver reliable and user‑centric solutions.

Support the execution of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for solutions related to Industry 4.0, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and related applications.

Collaborate closely with manufacturing, cybersecurity and IT teams to deliver user-centric solutions compliant to cybersecurity standards.
Support local users involving Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) with regards to on-site first level support.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, user guides, and training materials for operational teams.
Support DevOps and deployment activities for in‑house developed software.
Assist in maintaining on‑premise application infrastructure by performing basic monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational tasks.

Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering or related field.
At least 2 years’ experience in full-stack (backend/frontend) development.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do.
